name: Lord Krishna
title: The Supreme Guide & Teacher of Bhagavad Gita
symbolism: Flute represents divine music that attracts souls; Peacock feather represents purity and divine beauty.
teachings: Focus on your duty without attachment to the result. When confusion strikes, seek wisdom and take righteous action.
modern_application: In college and work, give your 100% effort in studying or working rather than burning out stressing over the results.

name: Lord Shiva
title: The Embodiment of Meditation, Inner Peace & Transformation
symbolism: Third eye represents spiritual knowledge destroying ignorance; Crescent moon represents mastery over time and mind; Trishula represents control over mind, ego, and intellect.
teachings: True power lies in self-mastery, calmness of mind, and the ability to let go of material obsessions.
modern_application: When overloaded with digital distractions and stress, pause, disconnect, and practice silent mindfulness for mental peace.

name: Lord Ganesha
title: Lord of Wisdom, Intellect & Remover of Obstacles
symbolism: Large head signifies broad thinking; Small mouth means talk less; Large ears mean listen more; Mouse vehicle means controlling desires.
teachings: Always seek intellect and wisdom before starting new endeavors. Listen attentively and analyze before speaking.
modern_application: Before starting an exam or a major project, clear mental blocks, stay humble, and listen carefully to learn effectively.

name: Goddess Saraswati
title: Goddess of Knowledge, Arts, Music & Learning
symbolism: Veena represents harmony of intellect and mind; White saree represents purity of true knowledge; Swan represents discerning good from bad.
teachings: True learning is not just memorization for grades, but understanding truth and developing creative intelligence.
modern_application: Approach your college education with dedication and curiosity, using digital tools to gain real skill, not shortcuts.

name: Lord Hanuman
title: The Embodiment of Devotion, Strength & Courage
symbolism: Mace represents moral strength; Flying represents transcending worldly limitations through faith and dedication.
teachings: True strength is always accompanied by humility and service to the noble cause. Dedicate yourself completely to what is right.
modern_application: Stand up bravely against negative peer pressure and support your friends selflessly with loyalty and courage.

name: Goddess Durga
title: The Protective Mother & Destroyer of Fear
symbolism: Riding a lion shows mastery over wild animal instincts; Multiple arms with weapons show multi-dimensional capability and readiness.
teachings: Defeat inner enemies like anger, laziness, doubt, and fear. Stand firm against injustice and cherish self-respect.
modern_application: Develop inner confidence to face career fears, self-doubt, and stand up against injustice or bullying.

name: Goddess Lakshmi
title: Goddess of Prosperity, Wealth & Righteous Abundance
symbolism: Lotus represents remaining pure even amidst murky worldly desires; Gold coins signify righteous, clean wealth.
teachings: Wealth gained through honesty and used for charity and well-being brings lasting peace and respect.
modern_application: Practice financial discipline early, respect resources, and share with those in need through charity.

name: Lord Rama
title: Maryada Purushottama - The Ideal Person of Truth & Duty
symbolism: Bow and arrow represent single-minded focus on righteousness and protection of truth.
teachings: Never sacrifice moral values or personal integrity for temporary comfort or shortcuts.
modern_application: Fulfill your responsibilities toward parents, teachers, and society with honesty, integrity, and discipline.
